name: Chain Letters
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of truthfulness and trust in the Lord rather than in human schemes, as seen in the call to speak out against sin (Leviticus 5:1) and to trust God above man (Psalms 118:8). The believer is encouraged to seek refuge in God's protection (Psalms 91:1; Isaiah 54:17) and to approach God with reverence and wisdom, avoiding foolish actions (Ecclesiastes 5:1). These principles caution against participating in practices like chain letters, which often rely on human manipulation and superstition rather than faith in God's sovereign care.
